reviews.text: Very kind and compassionate staff and doctors, they are really great and I highly recommend!

I can’t speak highly enough of Dr. Nori, she was very caring and took so much care of my dog, his cleaning was easy and smooth and he recovered fine afterwards, she called us twice to check on him after the cleaning and made sure he was doing well after the procedure, it’s really rare these days to find someone who really cares and she does! I would highly recommend your bring your pet to see her and she will treat them like family

Do not go here!!!!!my dog ended up dying the next day… I took my dog because he had been vomiting for a few days I got concerned. They had not even seen him yet and they told me everything they wanted to do to him, in my desperation I agreed. I ended up paying about 1k and they didn’t give me any answers. They said to go somewhere else where they can check him again because they didn’t know what was wrong??? On top of that the vet didn’t even give me information in all the test she did, I had to call back and ask again about them, and they were like “oh yeah their normal”.. super frustrating, they are in the business just for the money , they do not care for your dog!!! Unfortunately my dog passed away the next day. I wish they could have at least warned me he was going to decline that fast, there was zero urgency or concern. I never leave reviews but I do want to warn people.

I have brought my cat Misty to the vet 3 times to get a urinalysis and each time they tell me her bladder is too small and to collect it myself! The incompetence is very worrisome. Today I brought Misty in and SAMANTHA the receptionist barely gave me a hello or Good morning as I walked in and greeted her. Both receptionists completely ignored me and I felt very small and unseen after spending my money here for the past 3 days!! She then proceeded to have me WAIT while she searches on her laptop and continues to ignore me. The receptionist near her was free and asked to help me to which Samantha refused and had me wait for her to keep typing. After waiting 2 minutes I politely asked the receptionist who was not busy to help me and he did very kindly. The Receptionist SAMANTHA is the reason why I will not be returning to Banfield and I am highly disappointed on the services I received over the past 3 DAYS.

I had a 3:30 PM appointment for my dog at Banfield Chatsworth. We arrived 10 minutes early to check in and were placed in a room right away. The clinic was empty, yet we waited 40 minutes and no one came in to acknowledge us or explain the delay. I left with my dog. We will not be returning to this Banfield, we’ll be going back to our regular Banfield in Northridge. Very disappointed with the customer service, if this is how they handle timely appointments, imagine what happens if someone is running late.

I started coming here when my previous dog, my soul dog Mocha became very ill. The whole care staff was very supportive, compassionate and caring. Unfortunately, Mocha passed. When I got another dog and was gifted with another one, I wanted to make sure that they get the best care possible so I took them to Banfield and got both of them care plans. The staff is truly amazing and they make sure that my little ones don’t miss any appointments and follow up’s. Give them a shot, it’ll be one of the best decisions you’ll make.

I do not recommend this location for your pet's needs.  Went in to get a diagnosis for my pet and even though the results came in two days after the sample was taken, the staff sat on the results, and nothing was communicated to me.  I had to follow up with the location just to be met with a rude staff.  The vet said I was argumentative and yet they didn't want to take any ownership on their protocols.  If I got heated was because I care about the wellness of my pet and the lump she has on the side of her body has me concerned.  Too bad all they care is about upselling and charging for services and there is no follow up or follow through.

I take my dog Rocky to this location and they are absolutely amazing! Any time I needed an appointment they made accommodation and gave me an appointment to bring him in.

I now have a new dog Coco that needed to be checked asap and although it was last minute they took him in and provided excellent service and explained everything properly.

Thank you to the staff at this location. We appreciate it.

This was one of the worst customer-service experiences I’ve ever had at a veterinary clinic.

My dog needs an LDDS test because of high liver enzymes. This is not optional or cosmetic—it’s a serious diagnostic test. Yet the Banfield location in Chatsworth (91311) acted like scheduling it was a burden. They pushed back, resisted, and initially refused to book the appointment. It took a manager from another Banfield hospital calling them just to get an appointment made for today. That alone tells you how poorly this location is managed.

When I arrived, I was 20 minutes late. I understand punctuality matters, but what happened next was unacceptable: they immediately used that as an excuse to refuse to perform the test, with zero effort to help or problem-solve. An LDDS test involves timed blood draws every 4 hours, so a professional clinic would explain options clearly, offer a modified plan if possible, or at minimum reschedule in a reasonable way. Instead, they acted like they were looking for a reason to turn us away.

The practice manager, Katie, was hostile, dismissive, and confrontational. Her behavior was not just “busy” or “having a bad day”—it was outright disrespectful. I asked for the next available date or any alternative appointment, and she refused to schedule anything. No solutions. No accountability. No concern for my dog’s health. Just attitude.

Bottom line: If your pet needs real medical attention and you expect basic professionalism, avoid this Banfield in Chatsworth. They wasted my time, added stress during a health issue, and showed zero empathy or willingness to help. I will not be returning, and I strongly suggest you take your pet to a clinic that actually cares and behaves professionally.

Set an appointment for vaccines and everything because I'm moving away. Asked for my cats flea/tick medicine to be refilled for all four of my cats. I spend several minutes explaining this to the brunette at check in. When they bring my cat back, the tech gives me only one box. When I say I need it for all of my cats, she tells me they weren't aware. She goes back and several minutes later comes back to say they don't have enough boxes for my four cats to each get the medicine but I'm welcome to come back in a few days. I again explain I'm moving and this is literally my last day living here and that's why I asked. Nothing they can do unless I can come back.
God bless the redheaded girl who got there while I was there. She's helped me before and she's an absolute sweetheart. I asked her and she was just like oh no your dad can absolutely come pick it up for you or we might even be able to mail it to your new address let me check and get back you.
I also asked at check in and reminded the tech again when they took her I wanted them to cut her claws. When they bring her out to me, they say nothing.  I check and they're not cut. I ask the tech again to cut her claws and she says oh she bit me I can't cut her claws. Okay that's fine I totally understand that but were you planning on telling me that??

I moved somewhere there is literally no Banfield location so I tried to cancel my plan. The explanation I got for having to pay off the services my cats used was definitely never explained to me when I signed up. Owners beware!
Thanks for the 5 stars and for partnering with us for your pet’s health!

I had a hard time finding reviews for euthanasia so I’m leaving mine in hopes it will help the next person that finds themselves on this very difficult path.

My boy was 19. He lived a very good and long life. I came to Banfield to consult whether euthanasia was the most humane choice given his situation. Everyone from the front staff to the vet techs to the Dr herself were exceptionally kind and caring. They got me in immediately and never made me feel rushed at any point. The Dr listened to my ramblings and didn’t push any agenda or decision on me. She simply discussed what the options of waiting vs euthanasia would look like, based on her medical expertise.

I took my time but eventually decided putting him down was the most loving thing I could do for him. 😔

I wanted to give him a gentle and loving send-off after our 19 years together, and that’s exactly what the staff at Banfield helped me do. I never felt rushed and after it was “done,” they let me stay with him as long as I needed.

I chose not to have his ashes returned after learning that Banfield partners with a crematory that takes all the animals’ ashes and scatters them over the ocean.

I did buy the paw print and when I picked it up, it came in a very cute little box and gift bag. I loved how much detail and care they put into everything, no matter how “trivial” it may seem to others. And with all that, they were very reasonable on pricing.

Thank you Banfield staff for your kindness during such a difficult time and for taking such good care of my old man. ❤️

Whether it’s a routine check up, teeth cleaning, or an emergency one off visit, they always have my dogs best interests. They call with updates whenever my dogs are in their care and ask me about certain items before they proceed to do extra measures with my dogs. Big thanks to Eddie, Dr Alexandra, and Samantha.

I am beyond livid with the entire lack of customer service I received in regards to getting me pet's medications refilled in time.

I spent the entirety of last week speaking to people, leaving messages, and sending emails requesting that you get back to the pharmacy in regards to the refills. No one, in one week, got back to them. I spoke with someone (a man) at 9:41am on Friday and they said they were sending both prescriptions into the pharmacy. The pharmacy received nothing and AGAIN called you guys to confirm.

Today I was finally able to get a med refill to the pharmacy, and now, because it's so last minute, they won't have it ready until Monday PM. She has no medicine left and will miss 4 doses because of this. This is going to set her back in a big way. We just got her regular and on a good schedule and that progress is going to be ruined, thanks to no one in that office caring. This was absolutely absurd. No one should be made to wait any extended amount of time when it comes to their pet's medications.

What an awful experience this has been.
